fact: Regulation 01/20/CEMAC/UMAC/COBAC of 3 July 2020 on consumer protection, covering credit, microfinance and payment institutions (mobile money named as a risk), enters into force on 1 January 2021 and makes complaint services and CEMAC mediation compulsory.
title: Un nouveau Règlement CEMAC pour la protection des consommateurs de services et produits bancaires
